lessons.phenomenonOrContext: Three years of monthly high temperatures at one town repeat the same yearly shape without repeating exactly, and a town in the southern half of Earth records the opposite pattern in the very same months.
lessons.readabilityNotes: Short declarative sentences, one table read at a time, Fahrenheit values kept positive for Grade 3 number sense, and every question carried on an item with a real response control.
lessons.selectionReason: Chosen as the Wave 1 reference lesson because 3-ESS2-1 supplies genuine multi-year tabular data for NOTICE, the typical-versus-single-year idea gives LEARN a real conceptual move, the canonical correctness authority names three Grade 3 misconceptions that key FEEDBACK, and the Northern and Southern hemisphere record gives APPLY a transfer context rather than another repeated trial.

canonicalCorrectnessAuthority.outOfScope: The tilt of Earth's axis as the mechanism is Grade 5 and Grade 8 work and is not required here; a learner who states it correctly is right.
